scope: Non-author source review of small closed O2 CGU grouping and its declared controls.
static_checks: Changed route is gated by closed_executable, O2, requested count >1, and at most 2048 total machine instructions; O0/open/single-unit routes delegate to the existing partition function.
Count subtraction uses checked_sub and stops above the threshold; declarations without bodies do not contribute instructions.
Entry and codegen option rejection still precede lowering/partitioning. Target/backend/cache rejection, Verified-bound lowering and API preflight remain present.
Single-unit retention keeps the original complete Module; internalization uses the existing current-LIR/semantic-reference algorithm.
Reported requested_units remains the user request; actual_units/jobs and explicit fallback expose the changed plan.
Added model controls distinguish 2047/2048/2049 instructions, retain a cross-unit external target above the boundary, and preserve unchanged routes.
Native integration assertions cover both backends when llvm-api is enabled, selected entry, exported symbol behavior, public IR stability, invalid options and old output preservation.
git diff --check passed on the exact CP14 diff.

observations.detail: The 2048 threshold is a research heuristic, not measured evidence of a speed or runtime-quality win. Instruction count does not bound global initializer size, declaration count, or per-instruction optimization complexity.

Boundary unit tests use hand-authored machine-model fixtures; backend integration tests use independently verified hand-authored TypedIR. Neither alone proves source-language acceptance or native runtime nonregression.

execution.reason: No local Rust/LLVM; exact/equivalent-tree Actions results remain required.

required_followup: Run backend library tests and closed_executable_cp13 with llvm-api enabled.
Measure CP14 vs its baseline using identical O2 settings and retain native runtime quality per corpus; do not promote the prior CP13 NoGo solely on static review.
Keep the feature opt-in until those results support adoption.
